_note: DOMAIN FINDING, read 17 September 2026: zaya.ae is DEAD - it resolves to 208.91.112.55 (a parking/placeholder host), returns HTTP 403 over http and presents an untrusted certificate over https. ZAYA's live site is zaya.com (zayaliving.com also redirects there), and the content confirms it is the right company - Hameni, Nurai, Al Barari and Zuhha are all on it. The site is built on Wix, so every image in the page HTML is a resized derivative such as .../v1/fill/w_353,h_470,q_90,enc_avif,.../<id>~mv2.jpg. The URLs listed below are the untransformed originals behind those same media ids; I did not guess them - I requested each one and recorded the pixel size it returned, which is what the notes quote. CAUTION FOR THE WHOLE SITE: the two page-header photographs carry the display names ARW09486-HDR_edited.jpg and ARW09402-HDR_edited.jpg on ALL FOUR project pages, but each page has its own media id behind those names. The display filename therefore tells you nothing about which project an image belongs to. No form was filled and nothing gated was fetched. HAMENI-SPECIFIC FLAG: the six gallery images do not all show the same building. Four of them are a large rectilinear slab tower with a long podium pool; one is a completely different curved white tower standing on splayed columns with wavy planted balconies. I looked at every one and have described what I saw rather than assuming the page is internally consistent. The page describes a 33-storey, 498-home tower.
